correctness.rationale: Definitions, quantifiers and orientation were checked. Exact standalone standard-library calculation builds 20+150+500+625 nonempty directed forest faces and 53,845 barycentric flags, then 60 even permutations and 908 full-flag orbit cells. Signed boundaries square to zero. 451 integer unimodular ±1 cancellations leave C0=Z and C3=Z^5 with zero boundaries, proving all integral homology and absence of torsion. Independent signed Burnside check gives Euler -4. Jojić/Kozlov complete-source shellability gives original simply connected 256-sphere wedge. Three-cycles fix arc vertices and generate A5, so Armstrong proves quotient pi1=1; Hurewicz and Whitehead give wedge5 S3. No indefinite inference from finite experiments.

value.rationale: Even relabelings form the canonical nonabelian simple A5 (icosahedral) index-two subgroup, giving a mathematically motivated parity-sensitive orbit invariant. A5 quotient retains five integral three-sphere classes while the full S5 quotient retains only two; this first symmetric/parity contrast gives an exact integral homotopy class and excludes fundamental-group and torsion alternatives that rational invariant counts cannot settle. The result is not an arbitrary numerical slice or a routine parameter increment.
